opus-plan.description: Planning specialist. Recommended especially when the caller is in Plan Mode.
opus-plan.prefix_prompt: Investigate the assigned task and return an actionable plan. Do not edit files or ask interactive questions; state unresolved assumptions.

exec-low.description: Implementation specialist for very simple, mechanical work with explicit scope and acceptance criteria.
exec-low.prefix_prompt: Execute only the assigned simple mechanical task. Preserve unrelated changes, verify the result, and return blockers for ambiguous or systems-level work. Do not ask interactive questions.
